{{Quote|Kolovish lives in the mountains above. Once our leader, now she is our guide and protector.|[[Yuleph Phan]]|<ref name="Steps" />}}
'''Kolovish''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Rutian/Legends|Rutian]] [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Pilgrims|pilgrim]] who lived on [[Tython/Legends|Tython]] illegally, as well as a member of the [[Star Cabal]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|resurgent Sith Empire]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. The former leader and [[Matriarch/Legends|Matriarch]] of the pilgrims, Kolovish retired and lives in an ancient tower in the mountains.

==Biography==
{{Quote|I am Kolovish, first Matriarch and reader of the ancient texts. I led our people to this planet [...] My teachings angered our rulers. They spurned our lifestyle and refused to recognize the authority of the Matriarchs. On Tython, we found we could practice our ways in peace. Even the Flesh Raiders can't destroy our society&mdash;not forever.|Kolovish|<ref name="Steps" />}}
A [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Gender/Legends|female]], Kolovish was the [[Matriarch/Legends|Matriarch]] of a group of Twi'lek Pilgrims who followed her to the planet [[Tython/Legends|Tython]] in the aftermath of the [[Great Galactic War]]. Assisting in the establishment of [[Kalikori village]], Kolovish passed down her teachings to her followers, living among them for nearly two decades before retiring from her duties and leaving the village and taking up residence in an ancient stone tower farther up the mountain. [[Padawan/Legends|Padawans]] from the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order's]] neighboring [[Jedi Temple (Tython)/Legends|Temple]] would often seek out the Matriarch and ask her for her blessings before completing their training.<ref name="Steps" />

Near the start of the [[Galactic War]], Kolovish was discovered to be a member of the anti-[[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] and [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] organization known as the [[Star Cabal]] by [[Imperial Intelligence (Sith Empire)|Imperial Intelligence]].<ref name="The Watchful Eye" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|And it is my privilege to meet a Jedi who accepts our ways. Even our own kind&mdash;the other Twi'leks&mdash;they mocked us and denied the authority of the Matriarchs. That is why we came here. Now you've completed the ritual, and you are friend to the Pilgrims. You share our burdens and you share our strength.|Kolovish speaks to a Jedi who has completed a local ceremony|<ref name="Steps" />}}
A leader of the expelled Twi'lek Pilgrims on Tython, Kolovish found many Jedi who have arrived on their new [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] to be unable to complete the rites of her people. Nevertheless, the former Matriarch welcomed those who climbed the Kalikori path, even ones who saw that their duty was to the Jedi Order instead of the Pilgrims.<ref name="Steps" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|Remember us, and remember our ways.|Kolovish's parting words to a player who decides to request a material reward|<ref name="Steps" />}}
Kolovish appears in the Jedi-exclusive mission entitled "The Thousand Steps" in the [[2011]] [[BioWare]] game, ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="Steps" />
